❯ Which storage backend should the demo service use? Ask me before you decide.

● I will ask which backend to use before wiring anything up.
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 ☐ Storage

│ The demo service currently keeps everything in memory. Which backend should I wire up for persistence? Each option changes the setup steps
│ in the README.

❯ 1. SQLite file
     Zero setup, a single file next to the service. Good for local demos and tests.
  2. PostgreSQL
     Needs a running server and a connection string. Closest to production.
  3. Keep it in memory
     No persistence. Data is lost on restart, which is fine for throwaway demos.
  4. Type something.
